summary: Reduce clutter through inventory and reversible archive before permanent deletion.
instructions: Classify active, superseded, generated, reproducible, evidence-bearing, and unknown material before moving anything.
Default to a content-bound archive manifest and restoration path; permanent purge is a separate, later approval.
Do not remove dirty, active, locked, unmerged, or unregistered worktrees.
Retain the minimum evidence package needed to reproduce figures, statistics, and claims.
